structure:
Part 1 of 6 of Confluence page "Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4", version 210 (read from the tim envelope at workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/6497338582.json, .result.body, 162,599 bytes of storage-format HTML on one line; split onto lines in the part's working folder as body-lines.html, 1,878 lines, where this part is lines 1-461).

Read in full: (a) the page's preamble - an empty styled paragraph, then the intro paragraph (local-id 537b20a7409b), then the 'note' panel macro local-id 4f1c7678fb44 on fields applying to both journeys; (b) the h2 section heading 'Live Animal Data Elements' (local-id cebaec953cc7) and the three blocks between it and its table: the 'Applies at' note paragraph (36b3b13fe7fe), the three-level paragraph pair (ad438f592676 and c06b0b9ddeca: Level 1 Notification, Level 2 Commodity line 1..N per notification, Level 3 Unit record 0..N per line), and a second 'note' panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf) that this part also claims although the partition's 'read' does not name it - it defines the Mandatory column's five markings (Optional, Mandatory to proceed, Mandatory to submit, All-or-nothing, Conditional) and the always-valid rule; (c) the 'Live Animal Data Elements' table (ac:local-id 2e90e927-5a96-4a60-a08c-1856a37cde30): its header row of 8 columns (Field Name, Type, Conditions / Values, Applies at:, Source, Mandatory, Example, Impacts) and its first 13 field rows - reference_number, responsible_person_for_load, country_of_origin, region_of_origin_code_requirement, region_of_origin_code, internal_reference_number, commodity_selection, type_selection, species_selection, number_of_packages, number_of_animals_quantity, animals_certified_for, contains_unweaned_animals; (d) both expand macros nested in those rows' cells, read entry by entry: 'Number of packages commodities (54)' (local-id 8a3d204bab9e, 54 entries - the title count agrees with the list) in the number_of_packages row's Applies at cell, and 'Contains Unweaned Animals' (local-id 7345892ce2f2, 5 entries, no count in the title) in the contains_unweaned_animals row's Applies at cell.

Covered: every stated fact of all 13 rows - field name and anchor, Type, each condition and each permitted value, Applies at level, Source, Mandatory marking quoted exactly, Example quoted exactly, and Impacts markers - plus the two expands' full entry lists, the preamble notes, the level definitions, the Mandatory definitions and the column names. Six blank or N/A cells in these rows are claimed as gaps (reference_number Source, responsible_person_for_load Type, region_of_origin_code_requirement Source, internal_reference_number Source, type_selection's unlisted applicable commodities, species_selection's unstated 'agreed maximum', number_of_animals_quantity Conditions). The page carries no page-level status macro, so no claim here rests on an unapproved decision; the only status macros in this slice are the ANIMALS and GERMINALS journey markers in the Impacts column.

Stops at the end of the contains_unweaned_animals row (line 461); the next row, place_of_origin, is part 2's. Both expands this part claims are nested in the 'Applies at:' cell rather than the 'Conditions / Values' cell the partition's 'read' names - recorded as a decision, the content is the same macro either way.

claims.statement: The data specification for the EUDP live-animal and germinal-product notification is the Confluence page "Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4", at version 210.
claims.ref: Page metadata: .result.title and .result.version of workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/6497338582.json
claims.quote: Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4
claims.note: Page-level provenance rather than a field fact; recorded so later claims can be cited against this version.

claims.statement: The fields this page sets out are agreed rather than draft: the page carries no page-level status macro (no Draft, Proposed or Superseded) and its intro calls the fields agreed, so no claim drawn from it rests on an unapproved decision.
claims.ref: Preamble, intro paragraph (local-id 537b20a7409b); absence of any page-level ac:name="status" macro
claims.quote: This page outlines the agreed data fields required for the EUDP Live Animal journey, along with their defined characteristics and business rules
claims.note: The only status macros in this slice are the ANIMALS and GERMINALS journey markers in the Impacts column of each table row.

claims.statement: The page states the data fields required for the EUDP Live Animal journey together with their characteristics and business rules.
claims.ref: Preamble, intro paragraph (local-id 537b20a7409b)
claims.quote: This page outlines the agreed data fields required for the EUDP Live Animal journey, along with their defined characteristics and business rules

claims.statement: Every field on the page applies to both the animal journey and the germinal journey, and a field that applies to only one of them is marked as such.
claims.ref: Preamble, note panel macro (ac:name="note", local-id 4f1c7678fb44)
claims.quote: All fields apply to both the animal and germinal journeys. Any field that applies to only one is marked as such.

claims.statement: Where a field applies to both journeys but its permitted values differ between them, the page lists the values by journey.
claims.ref: Preamble, note panel macro (ac:name="note", local-id 4f1c7678fb44)
claims.quote: Where a field applies to both but the permitted values differ, the values are listed by journey.

claims.statement: A field's "Applies at" value says whether the field is entered once for the whole notification or is driven by the commodity the trader selected.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, note paragraph above the table (local-id 36b3b13fe7fe)
claims.quote: 'Applies at' shows whether the field is entered once for the notification or is driven by commodity selection.

claims.statement: "Notification level" means the field is entered once for the notification and is not driven by commodity selection.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, note paragraph above the table (local-id 36b3b13fe7fe)
claims.quote: Notification level means the field is entered once for the notification and is not driven by commodity selection.

claims.statement: Level 1 is the Notification: one movement event, holding reason for import, transport, parties, Place of Destination, Border Control Post and gross weight - the things that are true of the whole consignment.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, level paragraph (local-id c06b0b9ddeca), line 1
claims.quote: Level 1: Notification — one movement event. Reason for import, transport, parties, Place of Destination, Border Control Post, gross weight. Things that are true of the whole consignment.

claims.statement: Level 2 is the Commodity line, 1..N per notification: a commodity code plus its taxonomy chain (Type, Class, Species) plus a quantity - the things that are true of a specific commodity.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, level paragraph (local-id c06b0b9ddeca), line 2
claims.quote: Level 2: Commodity line — 1..N per notification. A commodity code plus its taxonomy chain (Type, Class, Species) plus a quantity. Things that are true of a specific commodity.

claims.statement: Level 3 is the Unit record, 0..N per commodity line: identifiers for an individual animal or germinal product such as ear tag, passport, donor name/ID and collection date - the things that are true per unit.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, level paragraph (local-id c06b0b9ddeca), line 3
claims.quote: Level 3: Unit record — 0..N per line. Identifiers for an individual animal or germinal product — ear tag, passport, donor name/ID, collection date. Things that are true per unit.

claims.statement: A field marked Optional can be left blank.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, Mandatory note panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf), bullet 1

claims.statement: A field marked Mandatory to proceed must be given before the trader can leave the page with "Save and continue" or "Save and return to overview".
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, Mandatory note panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf), bullet 2
claims.quote: Mandatory to proceed: must be given before the trader can leave the page with “Save and continue” or “Save and return to overview”.

claims.statement: "Cancel and return to overview" is always allowed, whatever is unfilled on the page.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, Mandatory note panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf), bullet 2
claims.quote: “Cancel and return to overview” is always allowed.

claims.statement: A field marked Mandatory to submit can be left blank while the trader is filling in the notification, but must be given before the notification can be submitted.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, Mandatory note panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf), bullet 3
claims.quote: Mandatory to submit: can be left blank while filling in, but must be given before the notification can be submitted.

claims.statement: An All-or-nothing marking applies to a group of fields: the whole group can be left blank, but once any field in it is filled in, all of them are needed.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, Mandatory note panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf), bullet 4
claims.quote: All-or-nothing: applies to a group of fields. The group can be left blank, but once any field in it is filled in, all of them are needed.

claims.statement: A field marked Conditional is only needed when its stated condition applies, for example required when Reason for import = Transit, and the field's level says when the condition is checked.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, Mandatory note panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf), bullet 5
claims.quote: Conditional: only needed when the stated condition applies, for example “required when Reason for import = Transit”. Its level says when it is checked.

claims.statement: Whatever a field's level, any answer the trader gives must be valid: the right format, within the length allowed, and chosen from the list where there is one.
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, Mandatory note panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf), closing paragraph
claims.quote: Whatever the level, any answer the trader gives must be valid: the right format, within the length allowed, and chosen from the list where there is one.

claims.statement: An invalid answer stops the trader leaving the page with "Save and continue" or "Save and return to overview".
claims.ref: § Live Animal Data Elements, Mandatory note panel macro (local-id e79cd9987acf), closing paragraph
claims.quote: An invalid answer stops the trader leaving the page with “Save and continue” or “Save and return to overview”
